seller.offer_name: FIM for federally qualified health clinics
seller.seller_pov: Attaxion reduces file integrity blind spots and compliance risk for regulated healthcare environments.
seller.outcome_hypothesis: The highest-value clinics are the ones with complex compliance exposure, small security teams, and visible operational risk.

buyer.company_query: federally qualified health clinics security leadership
pain_hypotheses: The clinic has compliance-driven pressure with limited security bandwidth.
The clinic runs legacy or distributed infrastructure that increases file integrity risk.
The clinic has recent cybersecurity or operational resilience signals.
buyer.scoring_goal: Rank clinics by likely security exposure, compliance urgency, and ability to personalize the outreach.

roles.purpose: Operational stakeholder who feels file integrity issues.

scoring_factors.name: compliance_pressure
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the account shows heavy regulatory or audit exposure.

scoring_factors.name: security_complexity
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the environment appears distributed or difficult to monitor.

scoring_factors.name: resource_constraint
scoring_factors.description: Higher when the likely team is small relative to the environment.

scoring_factors.name: reachability
scoring_factors.description: Higher when there are accessible stakeholders and visible context.
